svg.title: Commit First, Ship Second, Reconcile Every Dollar
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-commitment-to-cleared-cash; chart type: process_flow; title: Commit First, Ship Second, Reconcile Every Dollar; subtitle: Three separate earnings ledgers share one repayment calendar.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The wholesale lane records merchandise reimbursement and landed cost; the rewards lane records eligible card and portal receipts; the treasury lane records earned interest and qualified bonuses. Record each economic benefit once. Net-3 and Net-5 settlement terms are counterparty-specific commitments, not cleared cash.; caption: A card charge creates a repayment liability. Only settled contribution after merchandise, fees, losses, and operating costs can support owner profit.; stages: label: Validate the wholesale commitment; value: Step 1 — secure quantity, price, and acceptance terms; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check BuyForMeRetail, Pointsmaker, or MaxOutDeals terms for the exact SKU, receiving address, quantity limit, commitment expiry, inspection period, and payout clock. Reject purchases that rely on an uncommitted resale.; label: Price the three earnings lanes; value: Step 2 — separate merchandise, rewards, and treasury; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Calculate wholesale contribution without rewards first. Then evaluate Rakuten, TopCashback, and card offers against reseller exclusions, eligible categories, caps, and reversals. Keep treasury interest outside both purchase and reward contribution calculations.; label: Fund and document the shipment; value: Step 3 — reserve repayment before releasing inventory; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify DE, NH, or OR delivery treatment and applicable resale certificates. Capture serial numbers, parcel weight, insurance limits, and carrier acceptance. Store card closing and due dates beside each purchase.; label: Match receiving to cleared ACH; value: Step 4 — reconcile committed, accepted, and paid amounts; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Join order ID, tracking number, warehouse receipt, inspection adjustments, and bank transaction. An ACH initiation notice is not settlement. Escalate shortages and stop new commitments when counterparty limits bind.; label: Settle liabilities before sweeping; value: Step 5 — pay the card and invest only surplus cash; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Protect the full statement payment and operating buffer. Sweep only settled surplus into eligible bank accounts or maturity-matched T-bills. Record principal movements as balance-sheet transfers and earned yield separately.

rect.title: label: Validate the wholesale commitment; value: Step 1 — secure quantity, price, and acceptance terms; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check BuyForMeRetail, Pointsmaker, or MaxOutDeals terms for the exact SKU, receiving address, quantity limit, commitment expiry, inspection period, and payout clock. Reject purchases that rely on an uncommitted resale.

Keep treasury interest outside both purchase and reward contribution calculations.

Capture serial numbers, parcel weight, insurance limits, and carrier acceptance. Store card closing and due dates beside each purchase.

Sweep only settled surplus into eligible bank accounts or maturity-matched T-bills. Record principal movements as balance-sheet transfers and earned yield separately.
